_seed_note: Synthetic biomechanical priors. These mirror the default thresholds hard-coded in core/rule_engine.py (BicepRuleEngine: _check_rom min_range=80, _check_speed 1.0-5.0s, _check_tempo_stability max_cv=0.6, _check_tempo_symmetry min_ratio=0.7). They document the values the rule engine actually uses; they are NOT derived from recorded video or NSCA/ACSM tables. The runtime calibrator (training/data_collector.py) overwrites this file with video-derived values when run.
